brief: GS's equities mid-day color for Oct 27 reports a broad rebound led by tech: NDX +130bps (reclaiming its 100-day average), R2K +81bps, SPX +67bps, though breadth stayed weak (286 names down, SPX ex AI -50bps). The AI complex is the standout, with neocloud, optical, inference-chip, memory and semis baskets all sharply higher and a long-software/short-semis pair moving the expected direction. GS's tech desk attributes the AI strength to three drivers: easing of the AI financing-concern narrative after META's offering and AVGO's funding story, anticipation of hyperscaler earnings and capex from GOOGL, MSFT and AMZN this week, and an EPS beat from CLS plus a bounce off oversold conditions. Momentum factor is also recovering after a roughly 20% drawdown, though GS's prime-brokerage desk notes fundamental L/S momentum exposure remains near YTD lows post-degrossing. Trading volumes are down 7% and ETF share of tape is 27%, both slightly below average, while top-of-book liquidity improved 25% versus its 5-day average. The desk's own flow is skewed 1% better for sale, with long-only supply in comms and macro products against demand in tech and consumer discretionary, while hedge funds are 10% better to buy.
